summary: Initializes a device/session object a1 through a staged sequence of sub-calls. Returns 4 immediately when the object's first dword (offset 0x0) is already nonzero. Otherwise stores the state code a4 at dword index 36 (byte offset 0x90), runs sub_562D90(a1) then sub_562E30(a1, a3); when those succeed and a4 is 6 or 7, or SocketArrayCreate(a1) succeeds, zeroes dword indices 28 and 29 (byte offsets 0x70 and 0x74), stores SingleDelegationCall(a1) at dword index 38 (byte offset 0x98), sets dword index 343 (byte offset 0x55C) to -1, and when a2 is zero enters PollingLoopWithProcessCalls(a1). Returns 0 on success, otherwise the failing sub-call result.

local_names.a1: object being initialized; dword-indexed state is written into it
local_names.a2: flag; when zero the PollingLoopWithProcessCalls loop is entered
local_names.a4: state code stored at dword index 36; values 6 and 7 select the socket path
local_names.result: accumulated result of the staged sub-calls

operations.description: If the object's first dword (byte offset 0x0) is nonzero, return 4 immediately, treating the object as already initialized.
Store the state code a4 at dword index 36 (byte offset 0x90).
Call sub_562D90(a1); a zero result gates the rest of the initialization.
Call sub_562E30(a1, a3); a zero result gates the state-setup block.
Proceed into the state-setup block when a4 is 6 or 7, or when SocketArrayCreate(a1) returns zero (success); otherwise propagate the failure result.
Zero dword indices 28 and 29 (byte offsets 0x70 and 0x74).
Store the result of SingleDelegationCall(a1) at dword index 38 (byte offset 0x98).
When a2 is zero, enter PollingLoopWithProcessCalls(a1), a blocking processing loop.
Return 0 on success, otherwise the failing sub-call result.
